formulas.name: formula_Day1ARRCalculation
formulas.expression:
'Day 1 ARR Unadjusted (Rollup): $' & TEXT({!$Record.Day_1_ARR_Unadjusted_Rollup__c}) & ' + ' & BR() & 'Day 1 ARR Adjustment: $' & TEXT({!$Record.ARR_Adjustment__c}) & ' + ' & BR() & 'In Year ARR Adjustment: $' & TEXT({!formula_InYearAdjustmentAmount}) & ' - ' & BR() & 'Marketplace Day 1 ARR Impact: $' & TEXT({!$Record.Day_1_ARR_Unadjusted_Rollup__c} * {!formula_Marketplace_Discount}/100) & ' - ' & BR() & 'Partner Referral Fee: $' & TEXT({!formula_PartnerReferralFee}) & IF({!$Record.Marketplace_Impact_Override__c}, BR() & 'Marketplace ARR Impact Percent: ' & TEXT({!formula_Marketplace_Discount}), NULL)
/*Old formula below. New formula coming from SS-12832. formula variable formula_PartnerRebateDay1 and formula_MaxComputedTerm were deleted from flow 'Day 1 ARR Unadjusted (Rollup): $' & TEXT({!$Record.Day_1_ARR_Unadjusted_Rollup__c}) & ' + ' & BR() & 'Day 1 ARR Adjustment: $' & TEXT({!$Record.ARR_Adjustment__c}) & ' + ' & BR() & 'In Year ARR Adjustment: $' & TEXT({!formula_InYearAdjustmentAmount}) & ' - ' & BR() & 'Marketplace Day 1 ARR Impact: $' & TEXT({!$Record.Day_1_ARR_Unadjusted_Rollup__c} * {!formula_Marketplace_Discount}/100) & ' - ' & BR() & 'Partner Rebate Day 1: $' & TEXT(formula_PartnerRebateDay1) & ' - ' & BR() & 'Partner Referral Fee: $' & TEXT({!formula_PartnerReferralFee}) & IF({!$Record.Marketplace_Impact_Override__c}, BR() & 'Marketplace ARR Impact Percent: ' & TEXT({!formula_Marketplace_Discount}), NULL) */

formulas.description: A user can use the ARR adjustment field to modify their Day 1 ARR value
formulas.name: formula_Day1PlusAdjustment
formulas.expression: IF(ISNULL({!$Record.Day_1_ARR_Unadjusted_Rollup__c}), 0, ({!$Record.Day_1_ARR_Unadjusted_Rollup__c} + {!$Record.ARR_Adjustment__c} + {!formula_InYearAdjustmentAmount}) - ({!$Record.Day_1_ARR_Unadjusted_Rollup__c} * ({!formula_MarketplaceARRImpactPercent}/100)) - {!formula_PartnerReferralFee}) /*Old formula below. New formula coming from SS-12832. formula variable formula_PartnerRebateDay1 and formula_MaxComputedTerm were deleted from flow IF(ISNULL({!$Record.Day_1_ARR_Unadjusted_Rollup__c}), 0, ({!$Record.Day_1_ARR_Unadjusted_Rollup__c} + {!$Record.ARR_Adjustment__c} + {!formula_InYearAdjustmentAmount}) - ({!$Record.Day_1_ARR_Unadjusted_Rollup__c} * ({!formula_MarketplaceARRImpactPercent}/100)) - formula_PartnerRebateDay1 - {!formula_PartnerReferralFee}) */
